owner_queue.text: Owner step: Dropbox app: in the Dropbox App Console a scoped app with only `files.metadata.read` and `files.content.read`, redirect URI `https://<APP_DOMAIN>/panel/source/dropbox/callback`, then production status; its key and secret as `DROPBOX_APP_KEY` and `DROPBOX_APP_SECRET` in the `production` environment's secrets (the Worker requires them; `docs/deployment.md`, Owner steps 6) (**VC-21**).

Owner step: Stripe account for the product: a restricted key (Checkout Sessions write, Refunds write) as `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, a webhook endpoint `<APP_ORIGIN>/api/billing/webhook` (events `checkout.session.completed`, `charge.refunded`) whose signing secret is `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, both in the `production` environment's secrets (the Worker requires them); the prices in `src/lib/plans.ts` and the grace period `GRACE_DAYS` (30 days) (`docs/deployment.md`, Owner steps 7) (**VC-15**).

Owner step: `pg_trgm` next to `vector` on Neon, the Workers AI permission on the API token, and, on the owner's yes for the paid calls, `npm run index:hit-rate` against bge-m3 (`docs/deployment.md`, Owner steps 2, 7) (**VC-10**).

Owner step: after the first release, say the word for one measuring run on the hosted instance (the measured goals again on Workers, Neon and R2; the real-model search is a paid call); its table replaces the one in `docs/measurements.md` (`context/backlog/measured-gaps.md`) (**VC-23**).
Owner step: buy the domain and set `APP_DOMAIN` and `APP_ORIGIN` (**VC-4**).

Owner step: decide the plans' prices and currency (PRD OQ-2): the amounts for the monthly and yearly plan and the currency, or keep the placeholders (5.00 EUR a month, 50.00 EUR a year, `PLACEHOLDER_PRICES` in `src/lib/plans.ts`); gates the live release of payment, not the code; carried back from cockpit #46 (**VC-15**).

Owner step: dedicated Cloudflare account (Workers, R2 bucket with the EU jurisdiction, Hyperdrive, DNS), Neon project in an EU region with pgvector, and the `production` environment's secrets and variables named in `docs/deployment.md` (**VC-4**).
Owner step: generate `VAULT_SOURCE_KEYS` (`npx softure-connections key`) into the `production` environment's secrets; the Worker requires it (`docs/deployment.md`, Owner steps 6) (**VC-20**).

Owner step: live probe of the Obsidian Sync source with a real subscription (one standard and one end-to-end vault: connect, pick, sync a few notes) before the release that enables it; it uses `VAULT_SOURCE_KEYS` (**VC-22**).
Owner step: mail sending domain and provider key (**VC-2**, **VC-5**).

Owner step: observability backend account (OTLP endpoint and headers as `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS`), a contact point named `VaultConnector operator`, and `npm run grafana:alerts` to apply `grafana/alert-rules.json`; the operator's alert address as `ALERTS_MAIL_TO` and the admin list as `ADMIN_EMAILS` (`docs/deployment.md`, Owner steps 11) (**VC-13**).

Owner step: on that GitHub App, "Metadata: read-only" too, Setup URL `<APP_ORIGIN>/panel/source/github/setup`, a second callback URL `<APP_ORIGIN>/panel/source/github/callback`, a private key; `GH_APP_ID`, `GH_APP_SLUG` and `GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` (**VC-6**).

Owner step: one GitHub App for sign-in and the vault source: callback `<APP_ORIGIN>/api/auth/oidc/github/callback`, "Email addresses: read-only", "Contents: read-only"; `GH_AUTH_CLIENT_ID` and `GH_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` (**VC-5**, **VC-6**).

Owner step: reviewer account for the directory: upload `content/reviewer-vault/` to a bucket with a read-only key, set the `REVIEWER_VAULT_*` values, run `npm run reviewer -- --email=<reviewer address> --days=30`, give the printed password in the submission, and remove the account after the review (`docs/deployment.md`, Owner steps 13) (**VC-17**).
Owner step: set `OPERATOR_NAME` and `OPERATOR_CONTACT` (the operator named in the privacy policy and the terms; read at build time) (**VC-3**).

Owner step: set each plan's limits (notes, storage in MiB, searches a month) and the placeholder prices in `src/lib/plans.ts` (trial, paid, read-only after access ends); the hosted instance enforces them, a self-hosted one sets `PLAN_LIMITS=unlimited` (**VC-14**).
